No text, letters, digits, logos, watermark, paper, scroll, parchment, panels, frames, mockup, hands, table, external shadows or collage. VERY IMPORTANT: all illustrated subjects are SMALL, entirely surrounded by a VERY WIDE empty colored margin on all sides. Leave at least one seventh of the image width between every subject and the outer edges; the ground color alone continues to the edges. Do not enlarge or crop the subject. Keep the rest of the image calm for later large editable typography. A joyful FIRST birthday for a baby boy. One small adorable lime-green baby TURTLE with a sunny golden patterned shell, smiling gently, sits at the UPPER LEFT of the safe central area, with one tiny coral flower beside it. Bright saturated TURQUOISE ground throughout. The turtle including head, shell, feet and tail must fit inside a modest compact cluster with a generous uninterrupted turquoise border, like a small charming vignette. Premium flat gouache children's illustration, lively colors, no balloons, landscape or extra characters.

designs.name: Lavlje malo sunce
designs.motif: sa lavićem i toplim sunčevim bojama
designs.prompt: One original flat invitation BACKGROUND, portrait exact5:7, preferred1500x2100px. Full-bleed artwork itself, viewed straight on. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. No collage, mockup, paper sheet, parchment, scroll, card edges, table, hands, perspective presentation or external shadow. The underlying color flows continuously through the whole image; do not introduce a blank paper panel or frame. Keep every important ornament fully inside a5mm safe inset, about5% of the width. Leave naturally calm areas for large editable text to be added later, integrated with the composition. Warm joyful background for celebrating the birth of a baby boy. A tiny peacefully sleeping golden LION CUB, with an adorable rounded face and a small tuft of mane, lies nestled on two sculptural rich TEAL leaves near the upper center. Warm saturated APRICOT ORANGE ground throughout, with a few small sunny ochre circles as gentle accents. Contemporary polished flat gouache cut-paper visual style without actual paper sheets or shadows. Large quiet apricot space below the cub for big dark brown editable name and celebration details. Keep character and all leaves fully inset. Welcoming, vivid and tender, no beige panel, crib, moon, stars, crown or lettering.
